# Session (Google)

Google says session in the industry's sense of a [session][industry.session] in its command-line tools and SDKs; the ADK describes its Session as "The Current Conversation Thread" ([ADK sessions][g5]).

## Examples

- A session in the Antigravity CLI, with session ids ([Antigravity CLI conversations][g4]).
- A Session in the Agent Development Kit (ADK) ([ADK sessions][g5]).
- A session in Gemini CLI.
- A Session in Jules's API, where its app says task ([Jules changelog][g6]).
